text:
sam: Heads-up from last week's onboarding: users keep getting mixed signals from SDKs when calls fail. Some libs return strings, others throw subclassed exceptions. Creates a lot of guesswork in the UI.
neha: Yep. We ended up writing per-language adapters in the sample app. Painful. We should agree on a tiny, consistent surface.
jason: Proposal: a single error object with flat fields only. Fields: type, status, code, message, retryable (bool), retry_after_ms (nullable), intent, hint, metadata (optional list of k:v strings). Keep metadata compact for quota ids etc.
frank: For intent values, prefer verbs: "reauth", "retry_with_backoff", "reduce_rate", "contact_support", "noop". UIs map intent->button/flow.
sam: Mapping sketch: 400->BadRequest(noop), 401->AuthError(reauth if invalid_token, contact_support if revoked), 403->PermissionError(contact_support), 404->NotFound(noop), 408/429/503->Transient(retry_with_backoff, include retry_after_ms when provided), 5xx->ServerError(retry_with_backoff for 502/503/504).
neha: Important: Retry-After parsing. Servers send seconds or HTTP-date; proxies sometimes rewrite. Clients must normalize to ms and prefer an `X-RW-Retry-Ms` fallback header if present.
jason: Another tough one: streaming endpoints that emit an error envelope inside an otherwise successful SSE/chunked frame. SDKs must detect and raise the same typed error rather than handing back partial content.
frank: We should also standardize machine `code` values: invalid_token, revoked_token, rate_limit, quota_exceeded, server_error, bad_request. Small set to start.
sam: Example minimal JS/py shape we can show in docs (stringified): {type: "RateLimitError", status: 429, code: "rate_limit", message: "rate limit exceeded", retryable: true, retry_after_ms: 30000, intent: "retry_with_backoff", hint: "retry after delay or increase batch size", metadata: ["quota_bucket:free-tier"]}
neha: Test vector plan: header delta-seconds, header http-date, x-rw-retry-ms present, body-embedded error, streaming-frame error, oauth invalid_token, revoked_user. Cross-SDK tests are a must.
jason: For rollout: add a compatibility mapper in each SDK that translates old shapes into the new contract for one release, then flip the default. Also add unit tests asserting `code` and `intent` presence when relevant.
ops-bot: Canary scheduled: devex-sdk-js v3.0.1 to staging tomorrow 09:00 UTC.
docs-bot: Created doc issue: "Error contract: actionable intents + machine codes" assigned to @neha, due in 7 days.
frank: Small UX note: prefer short human `hint` not long paragraphs. The `intent` should be the primary machine-facing signal.
sam: I'll open the RFC with the table and starter snippets for JS/Go/Python. Drop test cases into the PR. Thanks!
